source_excerpt: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' begins its third week in theatres. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the film has performed well at the box office and crossed several major milestones since its release. Although its daily earnings have slowed during the third week, the film continues to attract audiences across Tamil, Telugu and Hindi markets. Its worldwide collection is also moving closer to the Rs 800 crore mark.'Jailer 2' nears another milestone at the box officeAccording to Sacnilk, 'Jailer 2' collected Rs 334.35 crore net during its first week, followed by Rs 95.55 crore in its second week. On Day 15, the film earned Rs 4.25 crore net, while its Day 16 collection stood at Rs 5.50 crore from 8,079 shows across India. The film's cumulative India net collection reached Rs 435.40 crore by the end of Day 16, while its domestic gross stood at Rs 509.45 crore. Meanwhile, its worldwide gross collection reached Rs 776.95 crore, including Rs 267.50 crore from overseas markets.'Jailer 2' Day 17 Live box office collectionAccording to Sacnilk, 'Jailer 2' has collected Rs 3.38 crore net across India so far on Day 17. The film is currently running across 4,616 tracked shows. The Tamil version remains the biggest contributor, earning Rs 2.48 crore from 2,186 shows. The Hindi version has collected Rs 55 lakh through 2,000 shows, while the Telugu version has added Rs 35 lakh from 430 shows. With these latest earnings, the film's total India gross collection has reached Rs 513.44 crore, while its domestic net collection stands at Rs 438.78 crore. These are live estimates, and the final collection for Saturday, October 31, is yet to be reported.'Jailer 2' day-wise box office collectionWeek 1: Rs 334.35 croreWeek 2: Rs 95.55 croreDay 15: Rs 4.25 croreDay 16: Rs 5.50 croreDay 17: Rs 3.38 croreTotal India net: Rs 438.78 croreTotal India gross: Rs 513.44 croreAbout 'Jailer 2''Jailer 2' features Rajinikanth as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, alongside Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar, Hrithik Roshan, Ramya Krishnan, Vidya Balan, Jackie Shroff, Mithun Chakraborty, S. J. Suryah and Yogi Babu. Nelson Dilipkumar has directed the action entertainer, while Anirudh Ravichander has composed the music.
